name: BM64Recomp [anylinux]
description:
Bomberman 64 Recompiled is a native PC port of the 1997 Nintendo 64 action platformer Bomberman 64. Using static recompilation, the original game logic runs natively on modern hardware without the latency or graphical glitches of traditional emulators.

Features:
- Native PC rendering with high-resolution and widescreen support
- Unlocked framerates and fluid camera movement
- Full support for modern controllers with customizable button mapping
- Enhanced audio fidelity and low-latency sound rendering
- Preservation of complete single-player adventure and four-player battle modes

This is an unofficial AnyLinux AppImage, which is able to work anywhere including glibc and musl. For more info: https://pkgforge-dev.github.io/Anylinux-AppImages/
